name: Organizational Structure Landscape
constraints: The landscape is read-only and never creates or edits units, teams, positions, assignments or their relations.
Every projected edge declares an axis and world-time interval.
Axis cardinality and cycle rules apply per axis and interval, never to the union graph.
One world-time and record-time pair applies consistently across all constituents.
A view is refused when any source cannot reconstruct the requested horizon.
Snapshots pin constituent versions and digests and carry an immutable output digest.
Generated snapshots are non-reimportable and cannot become source masters.
Project membership remains many-to-many and is not silently treated as hierarchy.
Supervisory precedence resolves at most one effective supervisor per assignment and axis where required.
Scenario facts never mix with authoritative facts.
holds: Cross-model reconstruction horizons and crosswalks are unverified.
Scenario branching is unsupported and must remain authoritative-only.
Independent Grok review and one frozen audit are pending.
